source.reference: Mnemonics and the TREZOR passphrase reuse the official BIP-39 cases in vectors/bip39/trezor.json. masterPublicKey and id were additionally recomputed with Node crypto (OpenSSL: PBKDF2-SHA512, HMAC-SHA512 'Bitcoin seed', secp256k1 ECDH public key, SHA-256) and, for the TREZOR cases, the master public key matches the official BIP-39 xprv.
